description: Immediately route generated Skill edits to canonical source and synchronization contract.

hooks.command: d="$(pwd -P)"; while [ "$d" != / ]; do if [ -f "$d/.codex/hooks/mirror_edit_context.py" ]; then if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$d/.codex/hooks/mirror_edit_context.py"; else printf '%s\n' '{}'; fi; exit 0; fi; if [ -e "$d/.git" ] || [ -f "$d/AGENTS.md" ] || [ -f "$d/AGENTS.override.md" ] || [ -f "$d/.codex/config.toml" ] || [ -f "$d/.codex/hooks.json" ]; then break; fi; d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; printf '%s\n' '{}'
